info.title: OnHold API
info.description:
The OnHold platform core. The web app uses exactly this API; nothing is hidden.

Authenticate with the session cookie (browsers; send `X-CSRF-Token` on writes) or `Authorization: Bearer ohk_…` (API keys). Workspace routes need `X-Workspace-Id` unless an API key implies it. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "field"?}}`. Writes accept `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries; records with a `version` accept `If-Match`.

post.summary:
Add a custom field. Existing records are not changed; a required field
is enforced on new records and on edits that touch it.

delete.summary:
Archive a field. Values already stored are kept but hidden; the key
cannot be reused.

patch.summary: Change a field's settings. Its entity, key and type never change.

get.summary:
What changed, in order. To sync: load everything, remember `latest`, then
read from it. Each event names the record that changed; fetch it if you
need it. A 410 `cursor_expired` means the events after your cursor are no
longer kept: load everything again.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Events after this position (`seq`); 0 or absent for the oldest kept.

get.summary:
The event stream, live. Each message's `id` is its position and its data
an event as in `GET /events`. Streams end after 15 minutes; browsers
reconnect on their own and resume from `Last-Event-ID`. A
`cursor_expired` message means events were missed: load everything again.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Start after this position; absent means only new events. The
`Last-Event-ID` header, sent by browsers on reconnect, wins.

name.description: Required when nobody is signed in (a new account is created).

password.description: Required when nobody is signed in.

oneOf.description: Present when a new account was created and signed in.

ActionResult.description: One action as planned or done, for the run log.

Address.description: A postal address. Every part is optional, but not all of them.

country.description: A country name or ISO code.

label.description: What the address is for: "Main office", "Stage door".

actor_rule_id.description: Set when an automation rule made the change.

oneOf.description: Set when an OnHold operator made the change while supporting this workspace.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last page.

paused.description: While paused no rule runs; events are still recorded and webhooks still sent.

Check.description: One comparison as evaluated, for the dry-run explanation.

actual.description: What the field held (absent if it did not exist).

confirm_slug.description: The workspace's slug, typed again to confirm.

except.description: The record being edited, which is not its own duplicate.

total.description: How many records match, across all pages.

custom.description: Only the keys sent change; `null` clears a value.

organisation_id.description: `null` clears it; likewise for the other optional fields.

email_opt_in.description: Consent to marketing by email, SMS and WhatsApp.

emails.description: Lower-cased; the first is the primary address.

phone.description: The primary phone number, if any.

phones.description: As entered; the first is the primary number.

role.description: Job title or role at the organisation.

permissions.description: What the key may do; at most what you can do yourself.

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Permanent.

position.description: Defaults to after the last field.

is_default.description: Make this the entity's default. An entity's first pipeline always is.

once_per_object.description:
Fire at most once per record (default true). Turn off for rules that
should act on every update.

body.description:
Jinja-style: `{{ thing.name }}`, `{% if %}`, filters `money`, `date`,
`datetime`, `address`, and `{% include "partial.key" %}`.

locale.description:
BCP 47, e.g. `en-GB`. Defaults to `en`, which also serves every
English locale that has no template of its own.

custom.description: Custom field values by key. Missing fields take their defaults.

stage.description: Defaults to the pipeline's first stage.

url.description:
`https://` (plain `http://` only for local development). Private and
internal addresses are refused.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens; permanent.

secret.description: The key itself. Shown once; store it somewhere safe.

owner_invitation_url.description: The owner's join link. It is also emailed; it is shown here in case it needs passing on.

DateOrder.description: How to read day/month order in dates like `07/03/2027`.

response_excerpt.description: The start of the endpoint's response body.

status_code.description: The endpoint's HTTP status, when it answered.

entity.description: What the template is about; default `thing`.

DryRun.description: The answer to "what would this rule do for this record?".

actions.description: What the rule would do, if it matched.

checks.description: Each comparison made, with the value found.

note.description: Why it would not act even though it matched, if so.

record_id.description:
Test against this record (of the kind the rule is about); otherwise
against sample data.

thing_id.description: The same as `record_id`, for rules about things.

new_organisations.description: Organisations a contact import would create.

sample.description: The first records as they would be saved.

Duplicate.description: A record that may be the one being entered.

reasons.description:
Why it matched, for people: "same email jo@example.com",
"similar name (82%)".

can_write.description: The caller may create and change these records.

fields.description: Core fields first, then custom fields in their order.

field.description: The request field at fault, for validation errors.

issues.description: Every invalid field, when there is more than one thing to fix.

has_more.description: True when there may be more right now.

latest.description: The newest position in the stream.

seq.description: Position in the stream; pass the last one you saw as `after`.

entity.description: What the field belongs to, e.g. `thing`.

key.description: Where the value lives: `custom.<key>` on the record. Permanent.

field.description: The field at fault, when there is one.

row.description: The spreadsheet row (the header is row 1).

create_organisations.description:
Contacts: create organisations the sheet names that do not exist yet
(default true). Otherwise such rows are refused.

oneOf.description: How to read dates like 07/03/2027; default from the workspace's locale.

default_currency.description: For amounts with no currency; default the workspace's.

on_match.description: What to do with a row that matches an existing record.

run_rules.description: Let automation rules react to the imported records (default false).

tags.description: Tags added to every imported record.

columns.description:
The field each column feeds, in column order (`null` to ignore a
column): a key from the upload's `targets`. Several columns may feed
`name` (joined with spaces) or a list field.

suggested.description: The field each column most likely feeds (`null` when unsure).

Issue.description:
A problem with one input field, for validation errors that name the
field at fault (`custom.budget`, `stages[2].key`, `actions[0].template`).

oldest.description: When the oldest of these was created.

oneOf.description: Absent for platform jobs (such as sign-in emails).

run_at.description: When it runs next (or ran last).

oneOf.description: Set while an operator is acting inside a customer's workspace; the UI must show it.

workspaces.description: Workspaces this user belongs to (empty while a second factor is pending).

position.description: Order in the list; default last.

body_html.description: Sign-in and invitation links are replaced with `[link removed]`.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the authenticator app.

recovery_code.description: Or one of the single-use recovery codes.

minor.description: Amount in the currency's smallest unit (pence, cents, yen).

custom.description: Custom field values by key. Missing fields take their defaults.

csv.description:
The file's text: CSV with a header row, separated by commas,
semicolons or tabs. Save spreadsheets as CSV (UTF-8).

custom.description: Custom field values by key. Missing fields take their defaults.
Custom field values by key. Missing fields take their defaults.

except.description: The record being edited, which is not its own duplicate.

total.description: How many records match, across all pages.

custom.description: Only the keys sent change; `null` clears a value.

org_type.description: `null` clears it; likewise for the other optional fields.
Free text: venue, promoter, brand, festival, agency…

tax_id.description: VAT or other tax registration number.

current_password.description: Required when the account already has a password.

Perspective.description:
Whether the workspace represents talent (`sells`), books talent for its
own events (`buys`), or both. Changes vocabulary and defaults, never the
data model.

make_default.description: `true` makes this the entity's default pipeline.

stages.description:
The full list of stages, in order. New keys are added; missing keys
are archived (records in them stay until moved).

warnings.description: Variables the template uses that this record does not have.

entity.description:
What the template is about: `contact`, `organisation`, `talent` or
`thing` (the default).

overrides.description: Values merged over the context, e.g. `{"thing": {"name": "Test"}}`.

record_id.description: Render against this record of `entity`; otherwise sample data is used.

recovery_codes.description: Shown once. Each works once if the authenticator app is lost.

Role.description: A workspace membership role. A fixed set in v1.

roles.description: Permissions per role in this workspace.

propertyNames.description: A workspace membership role. A fixed set in v1.

dry_run.description: Log what would happen without doing it.

once_per_object.description: Fire at most once per record.

config.description: Columns, sort, filters: whatever the list needs to restore itself.

shared.description: Shared with everyone in the workspace, rather than the caller's own.

core.description: Built in, rather than a custom field.

currency.description: The fixed currency of a money field.

default_value.description: For custom fields: the default for new records.

field_id.description: For custom fields: the definition, as `GET /custom-fields/{id}` gives it.

group.description: The form section it belongs in.

in_list.description: Shown as a list column unless a view says otherwise.

key.description: The key in the record: `name`, `emails`, or `custom.<key>`.

read_only.description: Shown but not edited (counts, links kept elsewhere).

relation_entity.description: The record type a relation points at.

sort.description: What to pass as a list's `sort` to sort by it; absent if it cannot be.

validation.description: For custom fields: limits the server checks (regex, min, max, lengths).

SchemaFieldType.description:
A field's kind, as forms and lists draw it: the custom field types plus
the core fields' own shapes.

detail.description: A second line to tell similar names apart.

secret.description: Shown only now. The old secret stops working immediately.

SelectOption.description: One choice of a select or multi-select field.

csrf_token.description: Send this as `X-CSRF-Token` on every write made with the session cookie.

mfa_required.description: When true, call `POST /auth/mfa/verify` before anything else.

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Stages are matched by key on update.

allowed_next.description: Stage keys a record may move to from here; absent means any.

required_fields.description: Custom fields that must have a value before a record enters this stage.

reason.description: Recorded in the customer's audit log.

except.description: The record being edited, which is not its own duplicate.

TalentKind.description:
What a talent record books: a person, a group (act or crew), a space
(room, studio, stage) or equipment.

total.description: How many records match, across all pages.

custom.description: Only the keys sent change; `null` clears a value.

legal_name.description: `null` clears it; likewise for the other optional fields.

commission_percent.description: 0 to 100, up to two decimal places.

portal_user_id.description: The member who signs in to the talent portal as this talent.

talent_type.description: Free text: solo, band, DJ, speaker, studio…

key.description: What rules and the platform refer to it by, e.g. `quote.sent`.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last page.

custom.description: Only the keys sent change; `null` clears a value.

stage.description:
Move to this stage key. Refused (422) if the pipeline does not allow
the move or the stage's required fields are empty.

impersonator_id.description: Set when an operator acted on the workspace's behalf.

name.description: The member's name, when the actor is a current member.

action.description:
The audit action (`contact.updated`, `talent_member.created`), or
`message.sent` for a message.

object_name.description:
The name of what the entry is about, when it is not the record
itself (a member of the act, a contact at the organisation).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for older entries; absent at the end.

otpauth_url.description: Render as a QR code for the authenticator app.

secret.description: The same secret in base32, for typing in by hand.

UserId.description: A person who can sign in.

Validation.description: Type-specific rules. Only those that make sense for the type may be set.

entity.description: relation: the entity linked to, e.g. `contact`.

min.description: number: the smallest allowed value; money: in minor units.

min_length.description: text, long_text: length limits in characters; multi_select: number of choices.

regex.description: text, phone: the whole value must match this regular expression.

Variable.description: One variable a template can use.

events.description: Topics or patterns such as `thing.*`; `*` for everything.

secret.description: Verifies the `OnHold-Signature` header. Shown only now; store it safely.

WorkspaceId.description: A workspace: one tenant's data boundary.

version.description: Send back as `If-Match` when saving to avoid overwriting someone else's change.
